findings.summary: the pass-2 probe the done_when relies on records content null for google/gemini-3.8-flash and moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro, so two of the nine changed OpenRouter identifiers returned no completion — exactly the "not just a 200" case the done_when excludes — yet manifest.md artifacts reports "9 of 9 ... served as requested" and rubric.correctness claims each returned a live completion.

`assert DEFAULT_ESCALATION_MODEL == seat["model"]` cannot fail while sn-escalation names a model, because defaults.py:57 defines DEFAULT_ESCALATION_MODEL as get_model("sn-escalation") and get_model reads that same seat's model key, so the assertion compares the seat against itself; the test named for the refine rotation never invokes it, and putting the model back to claude-fable-5 keeps every assertion in it green.

LATEST is a hand-maintained mirror of the seat list the change itself authored, so test_openrouter_seat_is_on_the_latest_release_of_its_line can catch a drift off that list but cannot establish latestness; and the fetched record lists x-ai/grok-4.20 alongside grok-4.7, which reads as a later release of the same line that the choice of 4.7 does not address.

the proxy config still routes claude-opus-4.6, claude-opus-4.7, claude-sonnet-4.6, claude-haiku-4.5, google/gemini-3-flash-preview and deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash, and brief item 4 asked for every model identifier under imas_codex/ to be listed with its file and brought to the latest version or recorded as a genuine fallback; none of these appears in the manifest's identifier inventory.

the comparison table cites "the benchmark-backed dd-enrichment model (sonnet-4.6)" after the seat moved to sonnet-5.5, and the brief asks comments naming a retired model to be brought up to date or removed; imas_codex/cli/sn.py:3432 has the same defect, describing the judge default as "opus-4.8" where the seat is now opus-5.5.

the sn-escalation default is now sonnet-5.5, identical to the sn-refine default at settings.py:208, so the comment immediately above claiming escalation is "Vendor-diverse from compose and refine" is false in the defaults; vendor diversity holds only while pyproject overrides sn-refine to gpt-6-luna, and a section that loses its model key would make escalation and refine the same model.

`_assert_priced` duplicates `_assert_proven_pricing` in tests/standard_names/test_seat_exposure_calibration.py:60, which already owns "a route carries finite rates with official provenance", differing only by adding max_input_tokens; importing the owner's helper would keep the wider population without a second copy that can drift.
